jobs.description: Across state and local government, the software that powers everyday public services is being rebuilt around generative AI and agentic systems. AWS is hiring a Senior Solutions Architect (SA) to help Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) reimagine their products on AWS. You will work directly with the leadership and engineering teams of ISVs whose software runs 911 dispatch, digital evidence, court case management, permitting and licensing, and benefits eligibility. Your customer is a commercial software company. Their customer is a government agency. Their end user is a constituent. This is an advisory role, focused on generative AI, agentic architectures, and the data foundations that make both work in regulated environments. You own the technical relationship with a portfolio of GovTech ISVs, and you lead the architectural deep dives that shape what they build. It is hands-on in a specific way. You will build prototypes and reference implementations, demonstrate that a pattern works before an ISV commits to it, and unblock their engineers when they are stuck. You will NOT ship production features in their product. The work starts with discovery. You ask about the platform, the constraints, and the requirements the ISV's government buyers impose, and you challenge the assumptions before you design to it. Much of the work is foundational: compute selection, well-modeled data across relational, NoSQL, and analytics stores, networking, identity, and cost at scale. The AI capabilities your customers want to ship are only as good as the platforms underneath them, so you will spend time on those primitives. You are effective when your ISV ships a better product on AWS. Ability to travel up to 30%. Key job responsibilities - Guide ISV architecture decisions across compute, data, networking, identity, and databases. Advise on the trade-offs and prescribe a solution. - Run discovery with ISV engineering and product teams to understand their platform, their constraints, and their customers' requirements before recommending an architecture path. - Lead generative AI work on Amazon Bedrock: agentic patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, guardrails, evaluation, and responsible AI practices that hold up in a public sector procurement review. - Help ISVs turn AI prototypes into production systems that meet the bar their public sector buyers require. - Help ISVs modernize legacy platforms onto AWS with phased strategies such as strangler fig, replatforming, and domain decomposition. - Explain how compliance shapes architecture in regulated state and local environments, including CJIS, StateRAMP, FedRAMP, HIPAA, and data residency. - Communicate architecture decisions to ISV CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and government CIOs. Structure the trade-off discussion, defend the recommendation, and adjust depth to the audience. - Help ISVs adopt AI-assisted development tools such as Kiro and Amazon Q Developer to accelerate their own engineering teams. About the team The GovTech Solutions Architecture team's mission is to be the best technology enabler for the ISVs who build software for state and local government and public safety. The work is technical, but the impact is human. The applications our customers ship affect how a citizen renews a license, how an investigator works a case, how a first responder gets dispatched. We take that seriously, and we look for teammates who do too. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.description: Join our QA team on Europa Universalis V. Build the dashboards and quality tracking that let anyone see the state of testing from data rather than gut feeling. Shape the functional QA process with us: test planning, coverage, merge-list curation and backlog health across concurrent update branches. Work closely with our external QA partner so that everyone is testing from a clear, prioritised queue. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Job Description Summary: As a Staff Data Engineer, you will lead the design and evolution of the data platform that powers BD Connected Care's AI initiatives. You will architect and build scalable data pipelines, models, and governance solutions that deliver trusted, high-quality data to Machine Learning engineers and other consumers across the organization. You will establish engineering standards, drive data quality and governance, and make key architectural decisions that shape the long-term direction of the AI data platform. Set the technical direction and standards that engineers across the team build against, make long-term AI data platform decisions , and design for source diversity so a new device, EMR, or supply chain source can be onboarded without redefining the model. Ingestion and Integration: Propose, design, and implement ingestion from BD product, operational, and clinical-adjacent sources into the analytics and ML data layers, spanning device transactions, inventory, ordering, purchasing, and supply signals, in batch, streaming, and change-data-capture modes. Data Modeling: Design relational and analytical schemas in the cloud data warehouse and the S3-based lake for forecasting, analytics, and feature stores. Author and tune complex SQL, build dimensional and event-based models, manage incremental loads, slowly changing dimensions, and late-arriving data, and deliver analytics-ready models for downstream consumers. Reconciled Histories: Build continuous, reconciled records that align events across systems with different refresh cadences and timestamps, covering procurement, storage, distribution, dispense, administration, waste, and return. Capture the observation time of each value alongside the value itself. Data Quality and Contracts: Own data quality as an outcome. Negotiate and enforce data contracts with producing teams, establish automated validation across completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness, apply confidence scoring to feeds that business and clinical claims depend on, and detect missing, stale, or implausible records upstream of the models. Technical Leadership: Mentor data engineers and review designs and code. Partner with ML engineers on feature engineering, dataset versioning, and reproducibility, translating operational and clinical context into the features and training datasets models need, and document architecture, schemas, data contracts, and operational runbooks in Confluence. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field. 7+ years of data engineering experience with increasing technical ownership, including end-to-end ownership of production pipelines and data models. Demonstrated architectural ownership beyond a single team: setting standards and driving technical decisions that other engineers build on. Expert SQL: query authoring, optimization, partitioning, distribution keys, window functions. Strong hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse at production scale, including schema design, performance tuning, workload management, and lake integration. Amazon Redshift (cluster or Serverless, with S3 via Spectrum and COPY/UNLOAD) is our current stack. Production experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, Athena, and streaming or CDC via Kinesis, MSK, or DMS. Python proficiency for pipeline code, with strong software-engineering habits: tests, code review, modular design, CI. Solid grasp of data modeling (Kimball/Inmon, event modeling), governance, lineage, and data quality practice. Hands-on feature engineering experience for ML: building, validating, and maintaining feature and training datasets in partnership with ML engineers, including point-in-time correctness and avoiding leakage. Ability to learn a business domain deeply enough to translate operational and clinical processes into the right data inputs for modeling, including which signals matter, how they are generated, and where they are unreliable. Demonstrated ownership of data quality as an outcome, including validation frameworks, anomaly detection on production feeds, and agreements with upstream producers. Practical knowledge of HIPAA and PHI handling, including access control, masking, and de-identification in production environments. Operational maturity: SLAs, monitoring, on-call, incident response, and post-incident improvement. Working in Agile/Scrum and documenting in Confluence. Preferred Qualifications: Master's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field. Healthcare or medical-device data experience (HL7/FHIR, device telemetry, operational and clinical data, ERP/SCM feeds). Experience in regulated environments with formal change control, computer system validation, audit trail, and data integrity requirements (21 CFR Part 11, GxP, or equivalent). Experience with dbt for transformations, and with semantic or metrics layers. Experience implementing lakehouse patterns on S3 (Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi). Experience supporting time-series and multi-series ML workloads, including temporal feature structures and dataset versioning for reproducibility. Familiarity with feature stores or vector stores (Feast, Tecton) for ML use cases. Experience building data standardization and entity resolution pipelines using third-party ontologies, NLP, or LLM-assisted mapping (Bedrock or similar). Experience with agentic AI pipelines and services, and with building AI-powered workflows and evals. Professional use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) with strong judgment around correctness, security, licensing, and review discipline. AWS Data Analytics Specialty certification. You find practical paths forward through difficult problems. jobs.description: Job Description Summary Become part of a winning team and help to deliver the Green Energy transition. As Valve Converter Electrical Project Delivery Team Manager, you will lead a Sub team and report to the Valve Electrical Team Leader who is responsibility for: 🌟Converter Valves Electrical Engineering & Technology Function for Converter 🌟Valves products development and design 🌟Valves electrical project engineering, electrical support for Valves manufacturing and aftersales. The successful candidate will be part of a highly motivated, dynamic and rapidly growing team of engineers working on the project activities related to HVDC applications. This is a very exciting and dynamic field of power engineering in which GE’s leading contribution has worldwide recognition to power global energy transition. The role gives an excellent opportunity for a motivated candidate to innovate, expand management skills, engineering skill and personal development within an internationally recognised expert in this exciting field. Whilst based at the HVDC Centre of Excellence in Stafford there will be international travel opportunities to collaborate with other GE units, test laboratories and customer sites. The role requires on-site work in Stafford, UK, 3 days a week (non-negotiable). Job Description Role Overview / Core Requirements: HVDC/Tendering: The successful candidate must have advanced experience in HVDC tendering. Technical Balance: The role is 50–60% hands-on engineering/design (reviewing calculations, simulations, site tests) and 40–50% leadership (mentoring a sub-team of 5–6 engineers, resource allocation, and project delivery). Experience Profile: While HVDC experience is ideal, we are open to candidates from the automotive (traction inverters) or power supply industries who can quickly learn the higher-wattage power electronics required. System-Level Perspective: A candidate with "full-cycle" experience (concept, prototype, test, manufacturing support) is highly desirable, as this helps with the prioritisation and quality control required in tendering. Operational Constraints: Location: The role requires on-site work in Stafford, UK, three days a week (non-negotiable). Responsibilities: Responsible for Valves design to size converter valve and cooling plant for tender and project; Responsible for Valves type test documentations by using design tools Responsible for Valves site electrical pre-commissioning test documents and approve of test results for correct performance of converters valve on site. Schedule and forecast the team’s work, define priorities and resource management; Team and people development through knowledge sharing and mentoring; Foster an environment of knowledge sharing, mentoring, developing within the team; Effectively communicates throughout internal and external functions, and clients. Ensure engineering processes, best practice and GE process is followed to deliver technical documents with the correct quality levels to meet the client and internal requirements; Collate and report teams KPI’s to deliver on time as per project schedule; Review and approve technical documents and ensure on time delivery; Lead team in solving challenging technical issues; Proactive interaction with other engineering departments for product definition (System design, Valve Converter Mechanical, Main Scheme, Layout, Commercial); Ability to make independent decisions to deliver technical document and support with the correct quality levels to meet the client and internal requirements for the work scope of the team; Ensure that work performed considers applicable international standards and policies Candidate Profile The candidate will be educated to degree level in electrical or electronic engineering and have significantly demonstrated experience in Power Electronics Converter design. An advanced understanding of power semiconductors, their control, protection and application is required. Previous experience of management of technical issues with client and contract is preferred. An enquiring mind and desire to learn new skills, an ability to apply different engineering disciplines and a willingness to share the knowledge are essential qualities. Qualifications/Requirements: Educated to degree level in electrical, electronic engineering degree or equivalent. If you are ready to make a difference and usher in a new era of clean, reliable energy, come join us. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral. In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GE Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector. Why we come to work: At GEV, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition. What we offer: A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities - including private health insurance.
